intro: Jobs similar to photographers are creative and hands-on roles in design, art and media. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Merchandise Displayers and Window Trimmers (73% similar), Floral Designers (73%) and Craft Artists (70%). Most sit outside the media field.
shared: These careers share an eye for composition, work with clients and turning an idea into something people can see. O*NET rates service orientation at 3.25 out of 5 for photographers. Display design, floristry, jewelry making and fine art use the same visual judgment. Only 3 of the 20 are in the same media group. Many pay more than the $44,660 photographer median, especially in film and design.

faq.q: Which jobs like photographer pay more?
faq.a: 15 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Special effects artists and animators earn $102,030 (128% more), theatrical makeup artists $97,150 (118% more) and Fashion Designers $80,960 (81% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. Animation usually needs a bachelor's degree.

faq.q: Is film and video editing similar to photography?
faq.a: Yes. Film and Video Editors are 70% similar to photographers and in the same media group. They earn a BLS May 2025 median of $75,420, which is 69% more than photographers, though the job usually needs more preparation, often a bachelor's degree.
